name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.
changelog: Fix Sonarr/Radarr custom-format profile imports: specification fields are returned as an array of name/value objects, but were read as a map, so custom-format scoring silently produced no matches. Parse fields as a list (case-insensitively by name), and log the endpoint and JSON path when a profile-import response is unreadable without leaking the API key.
